Apartments in summer (28 June – 29 August 2027)

In July and August the complex is not let as a whole. You book individual apartments 1–4, minimum stay 3 nights. In summer there is no charge for electricity or cleaning and no security deposit. In summer, apartment guests can also use the wellness area (Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, relaxation room and hot tub) for an extra charge. Prices and detailed rules will be published before the season starts.

Extra charges

  • Cleaning, handover and bed linen: CZK 1,950 per stay, added to the booking automatically. We make up beds for the number of guests you tell us; you make up extra beds yourselves (linen is in the wardrobe)
  • Electricity by actual consumption, CZK 8/kWh (including heating and EV charging), meter read on arrival and departure. As a guide: in winter, heating the whole property uses up to 380 kWh a day, about CZK 3,000 a day
  • Tourist tax per municipal rules, CZK 20 per person per night. When you rent the whole property, we deduct it from the security deposit together with electricity
  • Extras you add directly in the booking: terrace kiosk CZK 15,000, preparation day CZK 7,500 / 10,990, outside catering CZK 9,000, cot CZK 500
  • Dogs free when renting the whole property
  • Apartments in summer: no charge for electricity or cleaning, no security deposit; dogs CZK 250 per night; cot CZK 500

Packages for weddings and parties, companies and holidays have their own prices in the booking.

Pay the deposit by bank transfer no later than 3 days before arrival, or by card. On departure we deduct the electricity used, the tourist tax, any extra cleaning and any damage. The rest is refunded within 7 days of departure. For stays over 7 nights electricity is settled every week.

Terms

  • The booking is binding once the 50% advance payment is paid (due within 14 days).
  • Free cancellation more than 60 days before arrival; after that the advance payment is forfeited.
  • Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 10:00.
  • Quiet hours: keep noise down after 22:00, complete silence from midnight.
  • Do not switch off the pool and hot tub equipment (filtration, water treatment and heating). It must run continuously, or the water will spoil.
